approved_scope.title: Leave relayed decisions out of approval succession, the definition digest and the trusted correction history
approved_scope.description: Leave relayed decisions out of approval succession, the definition digest and the trusted correction history
acceptance_criteria: One of those records never changes what an approval, review or check decides, so an older SpecSync that drops it can still reopen and finish the change.

answers.constraints: change.3md 'Approvals are claims; relayed decisions (#633)' and Leif's 'Keep it out': a relay is covered by no digest and read by no gate, and the review digest and both correction digests already leave it out (correction_digest_projection, reviews_match_ignoring_relays); this change applies the same projection to the three comparisons that still see it. The anti-tamper rules stay: every other field of an approval, a reopen event or a correction is still compared exactly, so any non-relay edit is still refused (REQ-change-046 append-only history; the ledger-succession rule that a new generation supersedes exactly the approval the package closed on). change.3md 'A recovery has to work in the state the file is in (#904)'. Leif (2026-11-06, relayed by orc t18, 'One sentence'): CHANGE-13.h. Never weaken a gate, bound or test.
